source: Israel Meteorological Service rain gauges, annual normals 1981-2010
licence: Other (Open) (data.gov.il licence id other-open; no licence URL on the dataset page)
attribution: Rain-gauge data: Israel Meteorological Service, meteorological data archive, data.gov.il dataset 481 (https://data.gov.il/dataset/481)
selection: rain year Aug-Jul labelled by ending year; monthly codes [0, 7, 8, 9] used; Oct-May required; storage-gauge yearly totals as given; gauges within 1.0 km merged (lowest id first); >= 20 rain years in 1981-2010; inside the CHELSA clip
method: used by tools/hexgrid.py: ratio = station mm / CHELSA bio12 mm (bilinear at the gauge); IDW (power 2, km) of log(ratio) to every clip cell; corrected = CHELSA x exp(IDW log ratio); desert = corrected hex mean < 200 mm
